name: sqlglot-long
description: 36 changes sqlglot shipped -- optimizer, parser, executor and dialect bugs and features -- reverted source-only and handed over in one message. Long enough to take a Sonnet 5 session past half its 1M window.
files: Column lineage breaks on chained PIVOT and UNPIVOT
Oracle rejects the PIVOT and UNPIVOT sqlglot generates
Dropping an unnamed UNIQUE constraint breaks the CREATE TABLE
Support INSERT ... REPLACE USING
SingleStore: NULL ordering inside percentile WITHIN GROUP
SQLite: DATE_ADD with a computed amount generates a broken modifier
Doris: reserved words are generated unquoted
normalize_identifiers folds names it should leave alone
The Python executor ignores DISTINCT inside aggregates
An expression's hash is stale after append()
Pipe syntax: generated __tmp CTEs collide with outer CTEs
StarRocks: parse REFRESH EXTERNAL TABLE
optimize_joins rewrites joins it cannot reorder safely
Decorrelating EXISTS over a grouped subquery duplicates rows
MySQL: key parts of UNIQUE and INDEX pick up NULLS FIRST
GROUPING() gets the wrong type in the Hive family
qualify_tables strips the parentheses of a function body
Snowflake: PUT with an unquoted file:// source is not parsed as PUT
Dremio: support the four-argument REGEXP_SPLIT
simplify changes the meaning of arithmetic when it collapses a CASE or IF
pushdown_projections prunes columns that a positional column list still names
pushdown_predicates loses precedence when it inlines an aliased expression
Spark: GROUPING SETS as a suffix and as a GROUP BY element are confused
Transpile Spark's CONCAT_WS over arrays to Trino
Druid: JSON_VALUE with RETURNING
The optimizer scopes subqueries inside DML and DDL wrongly
simplify's gen() gives two different expressions the same key
A qualified star exclusion removes the column from every source
ClickHouse: LAG and LEAD are generated as lagInFrame and leadInFrame
T-SQL: star over an UNPIVOT expands columns in the wrong order
A second OFFSET silently replaces the first
GROUP BY reorders CUBE, ROLLUP and GROUPING SETS
Exasol: transpile MySQL's SHOW DATABASES and SHOW SCHEMAS
Hive: support NAMED_STRUCT
FETCH FIRST ROWS ONLY without a count becomes a bare LIMIT
DuckDB: table alias misplaced next to time-travel syntax
task:
This is a checkout of sqlglot, the SQL parser and transpiler. ISSUES.md lists 36 open issues against it -- bug reports and feature requests. Each names the tests that fail because of it; the tests are the specification.

Work through all of them, in the order ISSUES.md lists them, one at a time, without stopping to ask me anything. For each: make the change in sqlglot/, run its failing tests until they pass, and make sure you have not broken anything else. Never modify, skip or delete a test.

Run tests with `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider <test ids>`; the whole suite takes about a minute with `-n 8`. One test, tests/dialects/test_dialect.py::TestDialect::test_lazy_load, needs a `python` on the PATH and fails here whatever you do; it is not one of the issues.

When you have worked through every issue, end your reply with the words ALL ISSUES DONE.
nudge: Carry on with the remaining issues in ISSUES.md.
